rules.statement: A power of attorney duly executed in India is presumed to be valid under section 85 of the Evidence Ordinance, and a Sub-Registrar is authorized by law to execute and authenticate such documents.
rules.supporting_quote: That a power of attorney which is ex-facie duly executed in India attracts the presumption laid down in section 85 of the Evidence Ordinance that is was so duly executed and authenticated. Held further : That according to the provisions of the Indian Law applicable, a Sub-Registrar is a person duly authorised by law to execute and authenticate a document such as a Power of Attorney and therefore the document in the present case is ex facie duly executed
